Standardized GPR and the monthly change in log REER

Each chart is one country from January 2000 through December 2023. The top line is current-month standardized GPR (gpr_z). The bottom line is the current-month change in log REER (d_log_reer). The correlation next to the country name is the Pearson correlation of those two series.

d_log_reer begins in February 2000. Each country chart uses its own vertical scale. Source: cleaned/replication_cleaned/country_month.csv.
